The world is facing a diesel crisis, and its impact could reach your kitchen, your daily commute, and the prices you pay for essential goods. But why is diesel becoming so important in global geopolitics? And how could this crisis affect India?
From Donald Trump seeking Russian diesel to Ukraine attacking Russian oil refineries, this video breaks down the global fuel crisis, the Strait of Hormuz disruption, and the growing pressure on countries struggling to secure their energy supplies.
